en.title: Uploading Certificate Background Templates
en.excerpt: How to design, upload, and format background templates for automated digital tournament certificates.
en.content:
Graphic Design Specifications

Design your certificate background using tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or Canva following these parameters:

  • Orientation: Landscape A4 (297 × 210 mm).
  • Resolution: 300 DPI (minimum 2480 × 1754 pixels).
  • Format: High-quality PNG or JPG without pre-printed athlete names.

Uploading the Background Image

In Tournament Dashboard > Certificates, drag and drop your artwork into the upload zone and click Save Template.

Text Placement & Dynamic Fields

Archeris automatically renders dynamic text overlays on top of your background:

  • Athlete Full Name (bold font).
  • Club Affiliation & Category Title.
  • Achievement Badge (e.g., Gold Medalist, Top 8 Qualifier, or Official Participant).
  • Unique Certificate UUID and Dynamic QR Code.

Generating Test Previews

Click Preview Sample Certificate to view a rendered PDF test proof before batch generation.
